name: DOPE ROPE HOLIDAY ☕️ Hot Chocolate | 200MG | Premium Gummy Rope
description:
🎅 Gummy DeClause just rolled into town with his 🎁 Ugly Sweater Holiday Ropes.

🍫 Hot Chocolate is smooth, decadent, and a little too comfortable . . . the kind of treat that whispers “you up?” while the snow falls ❄️. Made for the naughty ones 😈 who still believe in miracles ✨ (and edibles 😉). Unwrap it slow 🎀. It’s not a race 🏁. It’s a Rope 🍬.

🔥 Limited Holiday Drop. Once it’s gone, it’s gone... just like your self-control 😵‍💫.

and just remember . . .
Last Christmas, I gave you my heart
But the very next day, you gave it away
This year, to save me from tears
I′ll give it to someone special
